### Read Seurat and ArchR object for plotting. 
#### Critical: change the directory to your working dir accordingly!
The DORC matrix was called with FigR. Here we provide called peak-GEX correlation dataframe and MAGIC-smoothed DORC/RNA matrix.
```{r include = TRUE}
RDSdir <- "/media/zeemeeuw/TAI-seq/mmTAI/RNA/" # output RDS file dir
ATACdir <- "/media/zeemeeuw/TAI-seq/mmTAI/ATAC/overlapped_harmony/" # ATAC root dir
seu <- readRDS(paste0(RDSdir, "lm_merged_overlapped_harmony.rds"))
proj <- loadArchRProject(ATACdir)

# load smoothed DORC and RNA matrix
load(paste0(RDSdir, "lm_merged_overlapped_harmony_mat_smoothed.RData"))
load(paste0(RDSdir, "calculated_seurat_gene_module.Rdata"))
# load(paste0(RDSdir, "gene_module.Rdata"))

k <- 10
trajectory <- 'Spleen.trajectory'
var_equal <- TRUE
cp1 <- 2.520776 
cp2 <- 27.545472 
cp3 <- 55.912739 
cp4 <- 97.637571
df_time_corrected <- readRDS(paste0(RDSdir, "chromatin_checkpoint_", 'Spleen.trajectory', "_k_", k, ".rds"))
```

### Adding TCR into into seurat objects
```{r include=FALSE, echo=TRUE, results='hold', collapse=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, fig.height=4, fig.width=5}
if(FALSE){
  dft <- read.xlsx('Lm-TCR4.57-clonotypes-paired in rna.xlsx') %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(tissue = str_extract(Tissue_time, "(.*)-", group = 1)) %>% 
  group_by(CDRa_CDRb, timepoint, tissue, barcode) %>%
  distinct(CDRa_CDRb, timepoint, tissue, barcode, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  slice_head(n = 2) %>% 
  group_by(barcode) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(cid = row_number())
  
  chain_1 <- dft %>% dplyr::filter(cid == 1) %>% dplyr::select(CDRa_CDRb, barcode)
  vec_chain_1 <- chain_1$CDRa_CDRb
  names(vec_chain_1) <- chain_1$barcode
  chain_2 <- dft %>% dplyr::filter(cid == 2) %>% dplyr::select(CDRa_CDRb, barcode)
  vec_chain_2 <- chain_2$CDRa_CDRb
  names(vec_chain_2) <- chain_2$barcode
  
  
  seu$chain1 <- vec_chain_1[seu$cellnames]
  seu$chain2 <- vec_chain_2[seu$cellnames]
}
```

### Gene module score of catch and slip bond TCR
```{r include=TRUE, echo=TRUE, results='hold', collapse=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, fig.height=3, fig.width=15}

# TCR info
meta <- read.xlsx('Lm-TCR4.57-clonotypes-paired in rna.xlsx') %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(tissue = str_extract(Tissue_time, "(.*)-", group = 1)) %>% 
  group_by(CDRa_CDRb, timepoint, tissue, barcode) %>% 
  distinct(CDRa_CDRb, timepoint, tissue, barcode, .keep_all = TRUE) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  dplyr::filter(!str_detect(CDRa_CDRb, "_")) %>% 
  # dplyr::filter(tissue == "Spleen") %>%
  dplyr::filter(timepoint == "d8") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(group = case_match(timepoint, c("d3") ~ "Priming", c("R5", "Y5") ~ "Recall", .default = "Primary")) %>% 
  group_by(CDRa_CDRb, group) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(n = n()) %>% 
  group_by(group) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(total_n = n()) %>% 
  ungroup()

tibble_tcr <- read_tsv('meta_cloned_TCR.tsv') %>% 
  dplyr::mutate_at(vars('id'), as.character) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate_at(vars('id'), ~factor(.x, levels = level_TCR)) %>% 
  arrange(id) %>% 
  dplyr::filter(group == "Primary") %>%
  dplyr::filter(CDRa_CDRb %in% meta$CDRa_CDRb)


dft <- read.xlsx('Lm-TCR4.57-clonotypes-paired in rna.xlsx') %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(tissue = str_extract(Tissue_time, "(.*)-", group = 1)) %>% 
  group_by(CDRa_CDRb, timepoint, tissue, barcode) %>%
  distinct(CDRa_CDRb, timepoint, tissue, barcode, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  slice_head(n = 2) %>% 
  group_by(CDRa_CDRb) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(count = n()) %>% 
  left_join(seu@meta.data[,c('cell_module', 'cellnames')], by = join_by('barcode' == 'cellnames')) %>% 
  dplyr::select(timepoint, tissue, cell_module, CDRa_CDRb, barcode) %>% 
  rename_with(~c("timepoint", "tissue", "cell_module", "chain", "cellnames")) %>% 
  dplyr::filter(tissue == "Spleen") %>%  ### filter sp
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(chain)) %>% 
  group_by(timepoint, chain) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(count_timepoint = n())

  
dft_d8 <- dft %>% 
  dplyr::filter(timepoint == "d8") %>% 
  dplyr::filter(chain %in% tibble_tcr$CDRa_CDRb) %>% 
  left_join(tibble_tcr, by = join_by("chain" == "CDRa_CDRb")) %>% 
  group_by(chain) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(EMTratio = sum(cell_module %in% c("Effector-memory_transition_1", "Effector-memory_transition_2", "Effector-memory_transition_3")) / n()) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(EFFratio = 1 - EMTratio) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(MEratio = sum(cell_module %in% c("Effector-memory_transition_1", "Effector-memory_transition_2", "Effector-memory_transition_3")) / sum(cell_module %in% c("Effector_1", "Effector_2"))) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(group = case_when(sum(cell_module %in% c("Effector_1", "Effector_2"))/n() > 0.7 ~ "Eff biased",
                                  sum(cell_module %in% c("Effector-memory_transition_1", "Effector-memory_transition_2", "Effector-memory_transition_3"))/n() > 0.7 ~ "EMT biased",
                                  .default = "no bias")) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(has_memory = case_when(sum(cell_module %in% c("Memory_1", "Memory_2", "Memory_3")) > 0 ~ "Yes",
                                       .default = "No"))
dft_d8$group <- factor(dft_d8$group, levels = c("Eff biased", "no bias", "EMT biased")) 
dft_d8 <- dft_d8 %>% arrange(MEratio)
dft_d8$chain <- factor(dft_d8$chain, levels = unique(dft_d8$chain))
dft_d8$id <- factor(dft_d8$id, levels = unique(dft_d8$id))

# module score
df_gm <- module_score_cd8[dft_d8$cellnames,] %>% 
  as_tibble() 
dft_d8 <- dft_d8 %>% 
  bind_cols(df_gm)

# checkpoint score
df_time <- df_time_corrected %>% 
  dplyr::filter(cellnames %in% dft_d8$cellnames) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(diff_raw = -diff,
                diff_spline = -diff_pred,
                dt_raw_cp3 = new_time - cp3,
                dt_spline_cp3 = old_time + diff_pred - cp3,
                old_time_to_cp1 = old_time - cp1,
                old_time_to_cp2 = old_time - cp2,
                old_time_to_cp3 = old_time - cp3,
                old_time_to_cp4 = old_time - cp4) 


data_time <- df_time %>% left_join(dft_d8, by = "cellnames") %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(x = case_match(bond, "catch" ~ 1L, "slip" ~ 2L)) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate_at(vars(bond), ~factor(.x, levels = c("catch", "slip"))) %>% 
  dplyr::filter(abs(old_time_to_cp3) < 20)



  

plot_list <- list()
for (metric in c("Naive", "Activation/Effector function", "Cytotoxicity", "Chemokine/Chemokine receptor", "Adhesion", "old_time_to_cp2", "old_time_to_cp3")) {
  cb <- combn(levels(data_time$bond),2)
  df_sig <- lapply(1:ncol(cb), function (i){
    conc_1 <- cb[1, i]
    conc_2 <- cb[2, i]
    df_sub <- data_time %>% dplyr::filter(bond %in% c(conc_1, conc_2)) 
    t1 <- wilcox.test(x = df_sub %>% dplyr::filter(bond == conc_1) %>% pull(!!metric),
                 y = df_sub %>% dplyr::filter(bond == conc_2) %>% pull(!!metric), 
                 # alternative = "less",
                 var.equal = var_equal)
    c1 <- tibble(p = t1$p.value,
                 xmin = df_sub %>% dplyr::filter(bond == conc_1) %>% pull(x) %>% unique(),
                 xmax = df_sub %>% dplyr::filter(bond == conc_2) %>% pull(x) %>% unique(),
                 y = max(data_time[[metric]], na.rm = TRUE) + 
                   (max(data_time[[metric]], na.rm = TRUE)-min(data_time[[metric]], na.rm = TRUE)) /10*(0.8*i),
                 group_1 = conc_1,
                 group_2 = conc_2)
    c1
  }) %>% Reduce("rbind", .)
  df_sig <- df_sig %>% 
    mutate_at(vars(p), scales::number, accuracy = 0.000001)
  
  
  
  p <- ggplot(data_time, aes(x = x, y = !!sym(metric))) + 
    geom_boxplot(aes(group = x, fill = bond), show.legend = FALSE, outlier.shape = NA, notch = FALSE, staplewidth = 0.5) +
    # geom_jitter(aes(fill = id, shape = bond), size = 2, show.legend = FALSE, width = 0.2) +
    scale_shape_manual(values = c(slip = 21, catch = 23)) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = color_bond) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(panel.grid = element_blank(),
          axis.text.x = element_text(size = 10, color = "black", angle = 45, hjust = 1),
          axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10, color = "black"),
          axis.title.x = element_text(size = 13),
          axis.title.y = element_text(size = 13)) +
    guides(fill = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 5))) +
    geom_segment(data = df_sig, aes(x = xmin, xend = xmax, y = y, yend = y)) +
    geom_text(data = df_sig, aes(x = (xmin + xmax) / 2, y = y, label = p), size = 2.5, vjust = -0.5) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = 1:2, labels = levels(data_time$bond)) +
    xlab(NULL)
  plot_list[[metric]] <- p

  
}
wrap_plots(plot_list, nrow = 1)

# save(df_time, file = 'figure_6ab.RData')
  

```

### UMAP distribution of selected clonotypes
```{r include=TRUE, echo=TRUE, results='hold', collapse=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, fig.height=5, fig.width=15}

# Fig 6C: Clonotype projection, d8
{
  dft <- seu@meta.data %>% as_tibble() %>% 
    dplyr::select(timepoint, tissue, cell_module, chain1, chain2) 
  d1 <- dft %>% dplyr::select(timepoint, tissue, cell_module, chain1) %>% rename_with(~c("timepoint", "tissue", "cell_module", "chain"))
  d2 <- dft %>% dplyr::select(timepoint, tissue, cell_module, chain2) %>% rename_with(~c("timepoint", "tissue", "cell_module", "chain"))
  dft <- bind_rows(d1, d2) %>% 
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(chain)) %>% 
    group_by(timepoint, chain) %>% 
    dplyr::mutate(count_timepoint = n())
  
  # d8 
  dft_d8 <- dft %>% 
    dplyr::filter(timepoint == "d8") %>% 
    dplyr::filter(count_timepoint > 30) %>% 
    group_by(chain) %>% 
    dplyr::mutate(MEratio = sum(cell_module %in% c("Effector-memory_transition_1", "Effector-memory_transition_2", "Effector-memory_transition_3")) / sum(cell_module %in% c("Effector_1", "Effector_2"))) %>% 
    dplyr::mutate(group = case_when(sum(cell_module %in% c("Effector_1", "Effector_2"))/n() > 0.7 ~ "Eff biased",
                                    sum(cell_module %in% c("Effector-memory_transition_1", "Effector-memory_transition_2", "Effector-memory_transition_3"))/n() > 0.7 ~ "EMT biased",
                                    .default = "no bias")) %>% 
    dplyr::mutate(has_memory = case_when(sum(cell_module %in% c("Memory_1", "Memory_2", "Memory_3")) > 0 ~ "Yes",
                                         .default = "No"))
  dft_d8$group <- factor(dft_d8$group, levels = c("Eff biased", "no bias", "EMT biased")) 
  dft_d8 <- dft_d8 %>% arrange(MEratio)
  dft_d8$chain <- factor(dft_d8$chain, levels = unique(dft_d8$chain))
  
  plot_list <- list()
  for(chain in levels(dft_d8$chain)){
    data <- data.frame(seu@reductions$UMAP_LSI_Combined_batch3.3@cell.embeddings) 
    data$barcode <- rownames(data)
    data <- cbind(data, seu@meta.data)
    
    xrange <- max(data$UMAPCombinedbatch33_1) - min(data$UMAPCombinedbatch33_1)
    yrange <- max(data$UMAPCombinedbatch33_2) - min(data$UMAPCombinedbatch33_2)
    p <- ggplot(data) +
      geom_scattermore(aes(x = UMAPCombinedbatch33_1, y = UMAPCombinedbatch33_2), color = "grey90") +
      theme_void() +
      coord_fixed(xrange/yrange) +
      geom_point(data = data[which(data$timepoint == "d8" & (data$chain1 ==  chain | data$chain2 == chain)),], aes(x = UMAPCombinedbatch33_1, y = UMAPCombinedbatch33_2, fill = cell_module), 
                 shape = 21, size = 3, show.legend = FALSE) +
      scale_fill_manual(values = mmjoint_colors) +
      ggtitle(chain)
    plot_list[[chain]] <- p
  }
  p2 <- list(plot_list[["CAASGTSGSWQLIF++CAWSLGVANTGQLYF"]],
             plot_list[["CALGEEGGRALIF++CASSPQGRTGQLYF"]],
             plot_list[["CALGEASSGQKLVF++CAWSLGLGNYAEQFF"]],
             plot_list[["CALGGTGGYKVVF++CASSPRDSDYTF"]],
             plot_list[["CAPGNSNNRIFF++CASRGYTEVFF"]])
  wrap_plots(p2, ncol = 5)
}
```

```{r include=TRUE, echo=TRUE, results='hold', collapse=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, fig.height=5, fig.width=20}
  dplyr::filter(tissue == "Spleen") %>%  ### filter sp
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(chain)) %>% 
  group_by(timepoint, chain) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(count_timepoint = n())

dft_d8 <- dft %>% 
  dplyr::filter(timepoint == "d8") %>% 
  dplyr::filter(count_timepoint > 10) %>% 
  left_join(tibble_tcr, by = join_by("chain" == "CDRa_CDRb")) %>% 
  group_by(chain) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(EMTratio = sum(cell_module %in% c("Effector-memory_transition_1", "Effector-memory_transition_2", "Effector-memory_transition_3")) / n()) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(EFFratio = 1 - EMTratio) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(MEratio = sum(cell_module %in% c("Effector-memory_transition_1", "Effector-memory_transition_2", "Effector-memory_transition_3")) / sum(cell_module %in% c("Effector_1", "Effector_2"))) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(group = case_when(sum(cell_module %in% c("Effector_1", "Effector_2"))/n() > 0.7 ~ "Eff biased",
                                  sum(cell_module %in% c("Effector-memory_transition_1", "Effector-memory_transition_2", "Effector-memory_transition_3"))/n() > 0.7 ~ "EMT biased",
                                  .default = "no bias")) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(has_memory = case_when(sum(cell_module %in% c("Memory_1", "Memory_2", "Memory_3")) > 0 ~ "Yes",
                                       .default = "No"))
dft_d8$group <- factor(dft_d8$group, levels = c("Eff biased", "no bias", "EMT biased")) 
dft_d8 <- dft_d8 %>% arrange(MEratio)
dft_d8$chain <- factor(dft_d8$chain, levels = unique(dft_d8$chain))
dft_d8$id <- factor(dft_d8$id, levels = unique(dft_d8$id))

  as_tibble()

  bind_cols(df_gm)


df_time <- df_time_corrected %>% 
  dplyr::filter(cellnames %in% dft_d8$cellnames) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(old_time_to_cp1 = old_time - cp1,
                old_time_to_cp2 = old_time - cp2,
                old_time_to_cp3 = old_time - cp3,
                old_time_to_cp4 = old_time - cp4) 


data_time <- df_time %>% left_join(dft_d8, by = "cellnames") %>% 
  dplyr::mutate_at(vars(bond), ~factor(.x, levels = c("catch", "slip"))) %>% 
  group_by(chain) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(EMTratio = sum(cell_module %in% c("Effector-memory_transition_1", "Effector-memory_transition_2", "Effector-memory_transition_3")) / n()) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(EFFratio = 1 - EMTratio) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(MEratio = sum(cell_module %in% c("Effector-memory_transition_1", "Effector-memory_transition_2", "Effector-memory_transition_3")) / sum(cell_module %in% c("Effector_1", "Effector_2"))) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(group = case_when(sum(cell_module %in% c("Effector_1", "Effector_2"))/n() > 0.7 ~ "Eff biased",
                                  sum(cell_module %in% c("Effector-memory_transition_1", "Effector-memory_transition_2", "Effector-memory_transition_3"))/n() > 0.7 ~ "EMT biased",
                                  .default = "no bias")) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(has_memory = case_when(sum(cell_module %in% c("Memory_1", "Memory_2", "Memory_3")) > 0 ~ "Yes",
                                       .default = "No"))

data_time$group <- factor(data_time$group, levels = c("Eff biased", "no bias", "EMT biased")) 
data_time$chain <- as.character(data_time$chain)
data_time <- data_time %>% arrange(MEratio)
data_time$chain <- factor(data_time$chain, levels = unique(data_time$chain))


# n_distinct(data_time$chain)
ggplot(data_time) +
```

```{r include=TRUE, echo=TRUE, results='hold', collapse=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, fig.height=4, fig.width=5}
dft <- read.xlsx('Lm-TCR4.57-clonotypes-paired in rna.xlsx') %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(tissue = str_extract(Tissue_time, "(.*)-", group = 1)) %>% 
  group_by(CDRa_CDRb, timepoint, tissue, barcode) %>%
  distinct(CDRa_CDRb, timepoint, tissue, barcode, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  slice_head(n = 2) %>% 
  group_by(CDRa_CDRb) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(count = n()) %>% 
  left_join(seu@meta.data[,c('cell_module', 'cellnames')], by = join_by('barcode' == 'cellnames')) %>% 
  dplyr::select(timepoint, tissue, cell_module, CDRa_CDRb, barcode) %>% 
  rename_with(~c("timepoint", "tissue", "cell_module", "chain", "cellnames")) %>% 
  dplyr::filter(tissue == "Spleen") %>%  ### filter sp
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(chain)) %>% 
  group_by(timepoint, chain) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(count_timepoint = n())

df_time <- df_time_corrected %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(old_time_to_cp1 = old_time - cp1,
                old_time_to_cp2 = old_time - cp2,
                old_time_to_cp3 = old_time - cp3,
                old_time_to_cp4 = old_time - cp4) 


data_time <- dft %>% left_join(df_time, by = "cellnames") 




# d3 checkpoint
{
  dft_d3 <- data_time %>%
    dplyr::filter(timepoint == "d3") %>%
    # dplyr::filter(tissue %in% c("Ln", "Spleen")) %>%
    # dplyr::filter(cell_module %in% c("Priming_1", "Priming_2")) %>%
    dplyr::filter(count_timepoint > 1) %>%
    group_by(chain) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(major_module = str_extract(cell_module, "(.*)_", group = 1)) %>%
    dplyr::mutate_at(vars(major_module), ~factor(.x, levels = c("Quiescent", "Priming", "Activation", "Effector", "Effector-memory_transition", "Memory"))) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(ratio_Quiescent = sum(major_module %in% c("Quiescent")) / n()) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(ratio_Priming = sum(major_module %in% c("Priming")) / n()) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(ratio_Activation = sum(major_module %in% c("Activation")) / n()) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(ratio_Effector = sum(major_module %in% c("Effector")) / n()) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(ratio_EMT = sum(major_module %in% c("Effector-memory_transition")) / n()) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(ratio_Memory = sum(major_module %in% c("Memory")) / n()) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(poly = n_distinct(major_module)) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(MEratio = ratio_Effector/(ratio_EMT + ratio_Effector)) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(desc(ratio_Quiescent), desc(ratio_Priming), desc(ratio_Activation), desc(ratio_Effector), desc(ratio_EMT), desc(ratio_Memory)) 
  dft_d3 <- dft_d3 %>% dplyr::mutate_at(vars(chain), ~factor(.x, levels = unique(dft_d3$chain)))
  d3_tcr <- levels(dft_d3$chain)
  
}

                   old_time_to_cp2 = mean(old_time_to_cp2, na.rm = TRUE),
                   old_time_to_cp3 = mean(old_time_to_cp3, na.rm = TRUE),
                   old_time_to_cp4 = mean(old_time_to_cp4, na.rm = TRUE))




R_val <- cor(data_time_avg$old_time_to_cp3, data_time_avg$ratio_EMT, method = 'pearson')
ggplot(data_time_avg, aes(x = old_time_to_cp3, y = ratio_EMT)) +
  geom_smooth(se = FALSE, formula = y ~ x, method = lm, fullrange = FALSE) +
  geom_point(aes(fill = ratio_EMT), size = 3, shape = 21) +
  scale_fill_gradientn(colors = choose_colorset("solar_extra")) +
  ylim(0, 1) +
  # scale_fill_gradientn(colors = choose_colorset("nostelgia")) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank(),
        axis.text.x = element_text(size = 10, color = "black"),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10, color = "black"),
        axis.title.x = element_text(size = 13),
        axis.title.y = element_text(size = 13),
        strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey90"),
        strip.text = element_text(size = 10, color = "black")) +
  guides(fill = guide_colorbar(ticks = FALSE, draw.ulim = FALSE, draw.llim = FALSE, 
                               theme = theme(legend.ticks = element_blank()))) +
  coord_fixed(ratio = (max(data_time_avg$old_time_to_cp3) - min(data_time_avg$old_time_to_cp3))/
                (max(data_time_avg$ratio_EMT) - min(data_time_avg$ratio_EMT))) +
  annotate(geom = "text", x = -20, y = 0.9, colour = "black", size = 5, angle = 0, label = paste0("pearson\nR = ",  R_val))
```
